item.tib: dbang 'bum lung gi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi gsol 'debs nam mkha'i sprin gyi me tog
item.coloph: ces dbang 'bum lung gi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi gsol 'debs nam mkha'i sprin gyi me tog ces bya ba 'di/ spyi bon tshogs mang gis yang yang bskul ngor/ yi dam gtso mchog dbang chen gyi thun mtshams su/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma pad ma dri med nam mkha'i mtshan can gyis sbyar ba bzhin legs par bkod pa'o/ dge bas 'gro kun bla med sa thob shog/
